description: Defines the Http2StructureDecoder class for decoding fixed-size HTTP/2 structures, including methods for starting and resuming decoding, handling buffer management, and tracking decoding state.

classes.name: Http2StructureDecoder
classes.description: A class for decoding fixed-size structures in HTTP/2, with methods for starting and resuming decoding, buffer management, and state tracking.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins decoding a structure from the buffer; returns true if successful, false if more data is needed.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Continues decoding a structure from the buffer after partial data; returns true if decoding is complete.

methods.name: Start (overload)
methods.description: Starts decoding with a remaining payload size, updating the payload size after decoding.

methods.name: Resume (overload)
methods.description: Resumes decoding with a remaining payload size, returning true if decoding completes.

methods.name: offset
methods.description: Returns the current offset in the buffer.
